title: Fun 3 hour tour of the city
text:
Wife: We had a wonderful experience with our guide Phillip. We saw some wonderful sights of the City and stopped for photos. He ensured we were safe along the way and made it a very informative and pleasant experience. We recommend!

Husband: it was a 10 year anniversary and a tour of Barcelona in the heat with Segways was a great experience. Philip is a great guide gave us the history of Barcelona some it's great secrets and his infectious personality. He was great fun. Make sure you ask for Philip he keeps you safe and engaged for the entire time.
author: Darren_A

title: Our guide was responsive to our needs.  Ouron
text: One of our group was a little concerned about riding a Segway.  Our quide paid special attention to her and assisted at all the street crossing and areas she was hesitant.  Also, his narration was good
author: Benjamin C

title: Very good
text:
They gave a brief introduction to Segway riding and the children were given an electric bike they liked to ride.
 During the tour our guide shared interesting facts about Barcelona as well as the history (both the younger and the medieval) of Barcelona with some pictures
author: H3752WKedwardl

title: Segway a great way to cruise the city!
text:
Found them on TripAdvisor because of their high rating. Our tour guide was Philip and we had a private tour just the three of us. The Segway's were nice and he gave us a quick tutorial in the square to practice. The tour went through old town then to a plaza, the main strips along the water, the beach, parks, and throughout the Olympic village.
Every stop he gave us a little bit of history about the two world fairs that were held in Barcelona as well as the Olympic Games. It was super exciting zooming through the streets and alleys of the city. We felt safe the whole time and never had any iss
author: Barbara_C

title: Fun
text: Excellent, great fun. Enjoyable experience with great guide.
author: Andrea200766

title: Barcelona in 2hr
text: Fun way to explore Barcelona, very informative and a lot of places covered.  Alex our guide is fun and knowledgeable 100%
author: MaTricia_O

title: Amazing Tim
text: We had the best experience in Barcelona on the Segway tour at the weekend.  It was so informative, with our guide, Philip, giving us lots of information about the history of the city.  It was super fun too and i couldn't recommend it enough.  Would definitely do again if we came back.
author: Paula_C

title: Great tour!!
text: Great tour highly recommend. Great way to see the city. We went on the three hour tour and will definitely be back. Tour guide excellent and knowledgeable.
author: steviedw2015

title: Fantastic experience for anyone & everyone
text:
It was our 5 year anniversary and we wanted to do something fun when on out last day in Barcelona (our first time here). I decided I would book the private 2 hour segway tour as it was out first time riding segways and as mentioned, our 5 year anniversary as a couple.
We met Alex, our tour guide, at their depot and he gave us a quick demonstration and let us practice using the segways before we set off as a 3.

author: Lewis_M

title: Fantastic 3 hour segway tour in Barcelona.
text: My husband and I have done segway tours all over the world and this was one of our favorites.  Philip was clearly knowledgeable about this city and its history.  This tour was the highlight of our time in Barcelona.  After we told him we were experienced riders he took us on more advanced routes including up to Olympic mountain.
author: Cabonewbie
